category_title: Students performing as rhythmic, collaborative poetry readers
scenario_title: High-energy physical behavior during whole-class share session
minimal_context: Bill and Kwame are demonstrating how they read a poem together during the whole class share session at the conclusion of the reading workshop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please demonstrate how you read the poem together for the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (In singing voices) Kwame: This is the way / Bill: Hey! / Kwame: we start the day / Bill: Hey!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, continue reading the rest of it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continuing in singing voices) Kwame: we get the knowledge / Bill: Hey! / Kwame: to go to college / Bill: Hey! / Kwame: we won’t stop there / Bill: Hey! / Kwame: go anywhere / Bill: Hey!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You are done performing. What kind of a cheer do you want?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Kwame: A poem cheer. / Bill: (swinging his poetry packet over his head) Don’t hurt the poems!
